tvShow.name: Whenever Possible
tvShow.overview: We're looking for someone who has free time to hang out with us. Whenever Possible.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Yoo Jae-suk and Yoo Yeon-seok will go around visiting ordinary people during their free time, aiming to spread a little luck into their lives. The two hosts will lead the team to undertake various challenges and missions that may occur unexpectedly around them.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: For the first episode of Season Four, Lee Je Hoon and Pyo Ye Jin, the hero and heroine of the mega series, 'Taxi Driver', are invited. The first Whenever Guest is a high school basketball player who wants to make special memories with his teammates before graduating. The second Whenever Guests own a music instrument shop in Nagwon Arcade. To win the prizes, they must flick a guitar pick to land it in a designated area. Will they be able to win the prizes?

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Choo Young Woo and Shin Si Ah visit Whenever Possible to promote their new movie, "Even If This Love Disappears from the World Tonight." The first Whenever Guest is a member of a community center dance club. They show off their teamwork of 15 years. The second Whenever Guest is a school cafeteria chef, who applied to make good memories with her colleagues before the school break. Will they succeed in winning prizes?

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: As this is the final episode of season four, Jea Seok is anticipating starting big stars. But contrary to his expectations, Lee Kwang Soo, his favorite junior, celebrates the last finale of the season with Park Bo Young. Kwang Soo performs unexpectedly well, but Bo Young experiences a meltdown during the spare time due to her strong sense of responsibility. Will they be able to end the season with a happy ending, giving all the prizes to the guests?

reviews.content:
# Season 02 Episode 01

I'm thrilled with the changes they made, especially with the improved editing. As I mentioned in Season 1, reframing the show to highlight how they bring joy—not just through prizes but through genuine interactions with celebrities—was essential. I also suggested adding a wildcard for guest participation.

I'm not sure if they saw my feedback or if it was a common suggestion, but either way, Season 2 Episode 1 delivered! It’s all about engaging with celebrities; the prizes are just a bonus. Keep that editing style, focusing on framing and scene use. Amazing work in S02E01!
